intro: I design algorithms that make hard decisions computable. My doctoral research builds multi-objective evolutionary optimisers and machine-learning surrogates for ship weather routing and accelerates them on multi-core CPUs and GPUs. In parallel, I work on language technology for low-resource Arabic, especially Sudanese Arabic, where data are scarce and annotation is costly.
dissertation: Multi-objective Weather Routing Optimization Based on AI Techniques and Parallel Acceleration Technologies

education.note: Current research area: multi-objective weather routing optimisation using AI techniques and parallel acceleration on multi-core CPUs and GPUs.
